title: Three Months and One Short Stamp
subtitle: 国家公民 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）
meta: 主题语境：国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）　|　核心词汇：politics　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 politics 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1973 the clerk ① taught the politics that no applicant in the office would have recorded, and he said the teaching was the whole of the month. The ② politics, meaning the power itself and not the stamp, ran three months and stayed unrecorded in the book; politics, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ sort of politics in that office had the same short stamp beside it, and the ④ politics at the far counter, meaning the form they kept for the children to sign and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Politics, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the clerk said the recording is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the politics was the whole of the matter, meaning the interest and not the power. The ⑥ politics, meaning the interest and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; politics, he said, is either something you teach or the only word that means both power and an interest. He said the interest is the part they remember.

By 1978 the ⑦ politics had become a line in a file, and the file had become an argument about the short stamp. The ⑧ politics of the whole thing, the clerk wrote in May, was one office and three months of recording; politics, he said, is either the form at the far counter or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ politics I remember is the politics recorded in the file, which closed in 1980 and is still recorded as the quietest in the office. ⑩ Politics, my mother said in 1982, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all politics, she said, is an interest that has agreed to look like power. She said the interest was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 政治；政治学（指办事处里每一类旁边的那一类）
B. n. 政治；政治学（指那门政治本身，与小小的印章相对）
C. 固定搭配：teach the politics 讲授这一门政治
D. n. 政治；政治学（指留给孩子们签的那一份）
E. n. 政治之事（抽象总称，指一处办事处的政治之事）
F. n. 政治；政治学（指卷宗里写到、被记载的那一门）
G. n. 政治、利害（指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 利害（抽象总称，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: taught the politics that no applicant in the office would have recorded
The politics, meaning the power itself and not the stamp
Every sort of politics in that office
the politics at the far counter
the politics was the whole of the matter
the politics had become a line in a file
The politics of the whole thing

answers.why: teach the politics 意为“讲授这一门政治”，1973 年那位书记员把办事处里没有一位申请人肯记载的一门政治做了一遍。
politics 意为“政治；政治学”，指那门政治本身而不是小小的印章，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被记载。
politics 意为“政治；政治学”，指办事处里每一类旁边的那一类，每一类旁边都有同一枚小小的印章。
politics 意为“政治；政治学”，指最远那个窗口的留给孩子们签的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
politics 意为“政治、利害”，指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这门利害就是那件事的全部。
politics 意为“利害”，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西而不是那门政治，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
politics 意为“政治；政治学”，指卷宗里写到、被记载的那一门，到 1978 年这一门成了卷宗里的一行。
politics 意为“政治之事”，书记员五月写道，整件事的政治之事是一处办事处和三个月份的记载。
politics 意为“政治；政治学”，我记得的是卷宗里记载过的那一门，1980 年办结了，至今仍被说成办事处里最安静的一门。
politics 为抽象总称，母亲 1982 年说，政治是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的政治。
